# Z1 Recycling Center - LLMs.txt
# AI-readable information about Z1 Recycling for generative AI systems

## Company Overview
Z1 Recycling Center is a lithium-ion battery recycling and sodium-ion R&D facility located in Mead, Oklahoma (Bryan County). We specialize in recovering critical minerals from end-of-life batteries using advanced hydrometallurgical processing.

## Key Facts
- Location: 8460 US 70, Mead, OK 73449 (Choctaw Nation territory)
- Facility Size: 60,000 square feet
- Operations Start: Q2 2027 (currently in permitting phase)
- Recovery Rate: 99%+ for critical minerals
- Technology: Hydrometallurgical processing with zero liquid discharge
- Compliance: 100% FEOC-free, IRA tax credit eligible, Justice40 region

## Services
1. EV Battery Recycling - Processing lithium-ion packs from electric vehicles
2. Critical Minerals Recovery - Extracting Li, Co, Ni, Mn, Cu, Al at battery-grade purity
3. Black Mass Processing - Converting shredded battery material to refined metals
4. Sodium-ion R&D - Next-generation battery technology research

## Battery Chemistries Processed
- LFP (Lithium Iron Phosphate)
- NMC (Nickel Manganese Cobalt)
- NCA (Nickel Cobalt Aluminum)
- LCO (Lithium Cobalt Oxide)

## Environmental Impact
- 70% reduction in CO2 emissions vs virgin mining
- Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) system - no wastewater
- 98%+ landfill diversion rate
- Closed-loop water recycling

## Strategic Advantages
- Oklahoma Critical Minerals Hub location with expedited permitting
- Central US location with direct rail access
- Skilled workforce from transitioning oil/gas industries
- Justice40 eligible for federal funding priority
- 100% domestic supply chain - no FEOC concerns
